name: test-assert-lite-workspace
description: Run your node:test and node:assert test files in browsers, as they are
author: Kawanet

scripts.fixpack: fixpack && fixpack packages/test-assert-lite/package.json && fixpack packages/test-assert-cli/package.json && fixpack packages/webdriver-js-cli/package.json && fixpack packages/playwright-js-cli/package.json
scripts.prepare: make -C builder is-not-buildable 2> /dev/null || make -C builder clean all test
scripts.test-max: make -C builder clean all test && make -C builder/pack pack test-dist && make -C browser test-playwright
scripts.update-test-title: find src sample/typescript -type f -name '*.test.ts' -exec perl -i -pe 's#(?<=^const TITLE = ").*?(?=")#($ARGV =~ s:^src/::r)#em' {} +
